gaps.finding: The live technical call code was captured directly from the project-specific MySMIS schema state and corroborated against official notices for the exact STEP-LLL Adults call.

The version chronology is reconciled: the consolidated STEP-LLL package was published on 13 August 2026 and a second corrigendum was published on 19 August 2026. A secondary article published on 24 August reports that 19 August corrigendum and updated Annex 4; it is not evidence of a distinct third amendment on 24 August. The exact current official MIPE PDF and Annex 4 DOCX URLs are known, but their binary bytes and SHA-256 hashes have not been captured because the MIPE endpoints are not retrievable in the available research environment.
gaps.resolution: Download the exact current official MIPE guide/corrigendum PDF and updated Annex 4 DOCX from the frozen URLs in EVIDENCE_ADDENDUM_006.json, retain the exact bytes, calculate SHA-256 for both files, then run final call-compliance QA. Do not make binary-dependent assertions before capture.

gaps.finding: A directly comparable NUTS2 adult-learning baseline is now frozen: 6.1% in 2022 from OECD/Eurostat and 11.4% in 2025 from an institutional mirror declaring Eurostat trng_lfse_04 as source.
gaps.resolution: Closed for regional adult-learning context. The indicator remains contextual and does not measure the AI/digital competence of the actual eligible >29 project population.

gaps.finding: Official quantitative evidence now exists for weak workplace digital use and a European Commission regional digitalisation proxy. In 2023, 22.5% of employees in the covered regional business-statistics universe used the internet professionally versus 41.8% nationally and 61.3% EU27; RIS 2025 also classifies cloud-computing performance as a severe relative weakness.
gaps.resolution: Closed at regional digital-maturity/proxy level. Do not translate these measures into a direct regional AI-adoption rate or individual AI-skill deficit.

In 2023, 28.4% of employees in the covered regional business-statistics universe used the internet professionally versus 41.8% nationally and 61.3% EU27; RIS 2025 also classifies cloud-computing performance as a severe relative weakness.
gaps.resolution: Closed at regional digital-maturity/proxy level. Do not translate these measures into a direct regional AI-adoption rate or individual AI-skill deficit.

gaps.finding: National/regional macro evidence demonstrates weak digital-skills and adult-learning context but still does not directly measure the AI/digital skill profile, barriers and work-use practices of the actual eligible >29 population intended for recruitment.
gaps.resolution: Run the three-region anonymous adult survey with documented recruitment frame and coverage metadata; ingest only real responses.

gaps.finding: Centru now has direct organizational survey evidence and all three regions have quantitative digital-use context, but there is still no comparable current employer evidence across all three regions identifying which AI/digital capabilities are insufficient in relevant workflows.
gaps.resolution: Run the employer/stakeholder survey in all three regions or freeze comparable official employer skill-shortage evidence with compatible definitions.

gaps.finding: ANOFM administrative data demonstrate a conservative registered-unemployed pool aged 30-55 of 72,824 across the three regions, so recruiting 160 is small relative to the macro pool. This demonstrates numerical feasibility, not that 160 is the measured magnitude of need or that 80/40/40 is the empirically optimal need-weighted allocation.
gaps.resolution: Retain 160 and 80/40/40 as project design values unless primary research/expressions of interest and a transparent allocation rule independently support those exact magnitudes. Do not present them as observed need.

release_rule: No final needs analysis may claim direct three-region target-group need, direct comparable employer skill-demand across all three regions, exact need magnitude 160 or relative need 80/40/40 while the corresponding blocking primary/scale gaps remain open. Final call-compliance QA also remains blocked until the exact current official MIPE GSCS/corrigendum and Annex 4 binaries are frozen and hashed.
